verdict.rationale: Deepgram documents a Smart Formatting parameter (smart_format=true) that formats currency amounts, phone numbers, and email addresses. Because it is an explicit request parameter, formatting can plausibly be left off, but the evidence never covers punctuation or casing and never documents a disable path or default behavior. Missing for 10: explicit punctuation and casing support, general number formatting beyond currency/phone, documented default and how to turn formatting off, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, transcripts come back with punctuation, casing, and number formatting applied, and I can turn the formatting off

citations.quote: Smart Formatting (smart_format=true), which formats currency amounts, phone numbers, email addresses, and more for enhanced readability
